description: Close one website issue as not planned (status dismissed): it stays closed when a later audit runs. The same write as update_issue with status dismissed. Closing a real problem as not planned hides it from the tracker, so do it only when the user said so. To stop one rule on some pages instead, use add_path_ignore. Needs the audits:write scope and an owner, admin or editor role, like the dashboard.

website_id.description: Website id the issue belongs to.

name: dismiss_issue
title: Dismiss an issue
